live_red_green_demonstration.summary: While pinning the fourth gate's validator refs into MPV2-0004, the plan-vs-evidence gate went RED on this tree in real time: the new evidence ref cloud/cloud-ci/gates/oya-cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement-app/src/read_contract_entry_surface.rs#evaluate_masterplan_v2_entry_surfaces was flagged masterplan_plan_evidence_unrecorded @ MPV2-0004@work_items[4].evidence_refs[4].unresolved because the committed generated-face resolution universe predated the module-extraction refactor.

Verification followed the CI materialize-then-assert protocol: gates asserted against regenerated faces (mirroring the producer-regen lane), then committed generated outputs were restored to branch bytes because generated outputs are never PR merge surfaces (generated-output-diff-policy verified green on the final diff).
